title: Corn at the Store
lines: Meg went to the store for corn.
The store had no more corn at all.
Mom told Meg to try the farm.
Mom and Meg ran a short path past thorns.
The corn was tall next to the barn.
Meg got a big bag and ran back.
Dad cut up the best corn of all.

questions.ask: Why did Meg go to the farm?
questions.listenFor: The store had no more corn, and Mom told her to try the farm.

questions.ask: What did Meg and Mom run past on the short path?
questions.listenFor: Thorns. It is one line, and it is the line most kids skim.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was glad she went? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason, like the best corn at the end.
